item.vehiclecore.bomb_bay.description: Drops TNT, does not destroy blocks but deals significant damage.
item.vehiclecore.telescope.description: A bulkier version of the spyglass.
item.vehiclecore.heavy_crossbow.descript: A heavy crossbow with significant power, requires arrows.
item.vehiclecore.airship.description: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.vehiclecore.cargo_airship.descripti: Slow and fuel-hungry, but carries an entire storage unit.
item.vehiclecore.warship.description: A flying fortress, slow but heavily armed.
item.vehiclecore.debug.description: This trusty, rustic debug will take you anywhere fast and rather reliably. Make sure your runway is long enough.
item.vehiclecore.gyrodyne.description: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.vehiclecore.quadrocopter.descriptio: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.vehiclecore.bamboo_hopper.descripti: A chunky aircraft with three seats and pontoons to land safely on water.
